title: Genotyping C. elegans
author: Justin Donnelly
materials: Lyse worms in a thermocycler according to the following protocol: 65 °C , 01:00:00 – 01:30:00 . 95 °C , 00:15:00 (proteinase K inactivation step). You can store extracted worm DNA indefinitely at -80 °C .

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer (no proteinase K)
steps.instruction: Mix 10 mM Tris‑HCl (catalog P212121), 50 mM KCl (catalog P212121), 2 mM MgCl₂ (Fisher Scientific catalog #AC223210010) and adjust to pH 8.3; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Add proteinase K to buffer
steps.instruction: Add Proteinase K (Molecular Biology Grade, 2 mL stock, New England Biolabs catalog #P8107S) to the lysis buffer to a final concentration of 0.5 mg/mL; prepare at least 10 µL complete buffer per sample.

steps.title: Aliquot buffer into PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Dispense 10 µL of the complete lysis buffer into each PCR tube; include one extra tube that will serve as the negative control.

steps.title: Pick single worm into each tube
steps.instruction: Flame‑sterilize a platinum wire, pick one adult worm from the NGM plate without puncturing the agar, submerge the wire into the PCR tube under flame, hold for several seconds to let the worm detach, then flame‑sterilize the wire before the next pick; aim for one worm per tube (a couple is acceptable, many will inhibit the reaction).

steps.title: Centrifuge tubes briefly
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes in a benchtop microcentrifuge for 15 seconds (00:00:15).

steps.title: Freeze lysates
steps.instruction: Freeze the tubes in liquid nitrogen or at –80 °C for at least 10 minutes (≥ 00:10:00).

steps.title: Set up PCR reaction
steps.instruction: For each tube add the appropriate Q5 PCR master mix and reagents:

substeps.instruction: If using poison‑primer amplification: add 46 µL Q5 master mix, 2 µL template (proteinase K extraction product) and 0.5 µL each primer.
If using standard amplification: add 47 µL Q5 master mix, 2 µL template and 0.5 µL each primer.
For the negative‑control tube: add master mix and primers only (no template).

steps.title: Run PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Run the PCR for 30–35 cycles following the Q5 manufacturer protocol; set the annealing temperature according to the primer sequences.

steps.title: Prepare PCR products for gel
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of each PCR product to a new PCR tube and add 4 µL New 6× Purple Loading Dye (NEB catalog #B7024S).

steps.title: Perform agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load the samples onto a 1 % agarose DNA gel and run at 120 V until the dye front reaches the end of the gel.

steps.title: Visualize gel under blue light
steps.instruction: Observe the gel using blue‑light illumination; for large‑scale deletions the band pattern may confirm genotype, otherwise proceed to Sanger sequencing.

steps.title: Set up sequencing reaction
steps.instruction: In a clean PCR tube combine 9 µL ultrapure water, 1 µL PCR product and 1 µL sequencing primer.
